title: Enterprise Connectivity: pricing undiscounted transfer subtotal
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this pricing undiscounted transfer subtotal rule to accepted-source pricing.

## Basis: undiscounted subtotal
For accepted-source pricing, subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price; this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal.

## Basis Q&A
| Accepted-source pricing basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Accepted-source pricing: Subtract the source tier monthly included outbound transfer from that period quantity and floor at zero, then multiply by its standard unit price | this gives the undiscounted transfer subtotal. |

## Hypothetical transfer subtotal
For a hypothetical accepted-source pricing, take monthly volume of 36 GB, included transfer of 20 GB and unit price USD 0.13. The excess is 16 GB, producing an undiscounted subtotal of USD 2.08. A hypothetical volume of 18 GB instead produces zero after the volume floor.
